candidate.name: intraday_range_amount_profile_alignment_js_240m
candidate.formula: On exactly 240 selected bars let r_i=ln(high_i/low_i), p_i=r_i/sum(r), q_i=amount_i/sum(amount), m_i=(p_i+q_i)/2, and score=1-[0.5*sum_{p_i>0}p_i*ln(p_i/m_i)+0.5*sum_{q_i>0}q_i*ln(q_i/m_i)]/ln(2).
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Clockwise co-location of intrabar auction width and transaction-value participation is consistent with price discovery supported by capital rather than isolated thin prints, potentially leaving a more persistent completed-session information state over the next three sessions.
candidate.source_grid: Require exactly the raw 09:30 row plus all 240 standard bars; select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 and exclude 09:30 from the factor.
candidate.range_rule: Require finite strictly positive high and low with low<=high; compute r_i=ln(high_i/low_i). Exact zero range remains a valid zero mass.
candidate.amount_rule: Require finite amount_i>=0. Exact zero amount remains a valid zero mass. Use raw amount participation without log1p, rank, clipping, winsorization, or another transform.
candidate.normalization_rule: Require finite R=sum(r)>0 and A=sum(amount)>0, then normalize the two complete fixed-support vectors separately to p and q.
candidate.divergence_rule: Use natural-log Jensen-Shannon divergence against m=(p+q)/2; every zero-probability contribution is exactly zero and no pseudocount or smoothing is used.
candidate.missing_semantics: Missing for invalid or duplicate source identity, source-grid mismatch, any selected invalid high/low/amount, nonpositive or nonfinite total range or amount, nonfinite divergence, or a score outside [0,1] beyond endpoint tolerance. Never impute, drop a selected bar, smooth, jitter, clip, bucket, rank, neutralize, or substitute another grid.
